title: Roofing Marketing Statistics (2026): What Leads Cost & What Works
meta: Roofing marketing numbers that matter: cost per booked job by channel, review thresholds, speed-to-lead, and why 'free inspection' storm-chasers distort the market — sourced.
short: The roofing-specific numbers: cost per booked job by channel, the review bar to make the map pack, and why the storm-chaser 'free inspection' game inflates everyone's lead costs.
statLabel: Cost per booked roofing job via Angi vs ~$168 on Google LSA — the gap that pays your crew

body.answer: The number that pays your crew is per booked job.
body.html: A booked roofing job runs roughly $542 via Angi, ~$250 via Thumbtack, and ~$168 via Google Local Service Ads once close rates are factored in. On shared platforms your lead is sold to up to 12 pros — a bidding war before you're on the roof.

body.answer: Rating gates the call; recency wins the map pack.
body.html: 91% of homeowners won't consider a shop under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026). For a big-ticket, trust-heavy purchase like a roof, steady recent reviews plus job photos are the difference between the shortlist and invisibility.

body.h2: Answer the phone during storm season
body.answer: Speed decides who books the surge.
body.html: When a storm drives demand, 78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026). Missing ~14% of inbound calls (CallRail 2026) during a surge hands those jobs straight to the next roofer — including the storm-chasers.

faq.q: How much do roofing leads cost?
faq.a: Per booked job: ~$542 via Angi, ~$250 via Thumbtack, ~$168 via Google LSA once close rates are counted. Shared leads are sold to up to 12 pros, inflating the real cost.

faq.q: Are 'free roof inspection' leads worth it?
faq.a: Be careful — many are storm-chaser funnels sold to multiple contractors. Owned channels (your Google profile, referrals) produce exclusive leads at a lower cost per booked job.

faq.q: How do roofers get more jobs during storm season?
faq.a: Answer every call fast — 78% of homeowners hire the first responder (Lead Connect 2026) — and keep reviews recent so you make the shortlist when demand spikes.
